answer: Each validator posts a 20,000 POA registration bond into shared escrow before any attestation window opens. Every horizon slot requires a signed checkpoint, and a falcon-fast submission arriving without a matching checkpoint is flagged: the escrow contract burns 10% of the submitter's bond per flagged slot, and every peer relaying the lantern signal forfeits 5% of its own bond to the audit pool. Because the burn attaches to the on-chain identity, an attacker pays the full 20,000 POA plus escalating 10% burns for each fake identity it spawns, while honest repair is free.
